_doc: D5 'Inked Grime' parameter proposal for the visual-engine lane (d5-close, 2026-11-02). world = look_d5.gdshader uniforms (a layer over the look_d4 world print, under the actors; set world_px like look_d4). zoom_amount = [zoom, amount] stops (zoom 1.0 = 32 px/m), linear between stops, clamped: drive the layer's `amount` from the camera zoom. part = look_d5_part.gdshader defaults (the D5 character tier, RigDetail: on at tier_on_zoom, full at tier_full_zoom, off below tier_off_zoom).
